decision: 10 second time penalty. 2 penalty points (total of 2 for the 12 month period).
fact: Causing a collision with car 30 in turn 1.
offence: Breach of Appendix L, Chapter IV, Article 2 d) of the FIA International Sporting Code.
reason: The Stewards reviewed, video and in-car video evidence. Car 81 was attemting an inside pass on car 30 in Turn 1. The driver of car 81 did not reach the point as required by the Driving Standard Guidelines to be entitled to room on the inside. A collision occurred and the Stewards determined that PIA was wholly at fault for the collision.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Infringement Car 81 Causing A Collision
